_meta.note: PURA prevention engagement layer for the care pathways: preventive reminders, the behavioural/lifestyle intervention catalogue, the alert framework, the condition-level 'Prevention Score', and KPI/outcome measures. Source: PURA prediabetes + diabetes workflows. Connects to Doc 11 (nudge engine), Doc 12 (actions), Doc 07 (experience), Doc 13/14 (validation), Doc 19 (actuarial). Illustrative — NOT a clinical sign-off.
_meta.alignment: Reminders/nudges should route through the Doc 11 §9 delivery engine (channels, quiet hours, consent, PHI-safe payloads, safety-critical escalation), not a parallel sender.

reminders.message: Your blood sugar monitoring test is due. Completing it helps track your progress and prevent diabetes.
Let's check your progress. A quick health review can help keep you on track and reduce your risk of developing diabetes.
Regular follow-up helps monitor your health and reduce the risk of developing diabetes. Schedule your visit today.

messages: Losing just 5-7% of body weight can significantly reduce your risk of developing diabetes.
Every healthy choice counts. Small changes create lasting results.
A 30-minute walk today helps improve insulin sensitivity.
You're one workout closer to your health goal.
Try filling half your plate with vegetables at your next meal.
Replacing sugary drinks with water can help lower your diabetes risk.
Your recent results show an increased risk of developing diabetes. Consistent lifestyle changes now can make a significant difference.

care_team: Worsening trend / non-engagement → Care Coordinator monitoring flag
physician: Progression to diabetes (HbA1c ≥6.5% / FPG ≥126) → high-priority physician alert + complication screening within 3 months

cds_rules.name: Progression to Diabetes
then: Confirmatory HbA1c in 3 months if clinically required
Baseline complication screening (kidney, eye, cardiovascular) within 3 months

prevention_score.name: Prevention Score (condition-level)
prevention_score.note: A condition-specific composite shown on the PURA prediabetes dashboard — distinct from the whole-person PureScore. Candidate to derive FROM PureScore inputs rather than as a parallel score.
